welcome.title: One more step and you're done
welcome.lead: The extension doesn't send notifications itself — that's the job of a small companion program on your computer: it listens to your AI agent and decides when you're worth interrupting. Without it the extension simply does nothing.
welcome.statusChecking: checking the connection to the companion…
welcome.statusConnected: Companion connected — you can close this tab.
welcome.statusWaiting: Companion not connected yet — follow the steps below, then press "Check again".
welcome.downloadHint: A single file. Nothing gets installed into the system.
welcome.step1.title: Download the file and double-click it
welcome.step1.detail: It unpacks the extension, registers the companion and opens the windows you need — nothing to type in a console.
welcome.step2.title: In the chrome://extensions window that opens, turn on Developer mode
welcome.step2.detail: The switch in the top right corner. It's a one-off and it's safe — Chrome deliberately requires it for extensions from outside the store, so that nobody can install one silently.
welcome.step3.title: "Load unpacked" → pick the folder that's already open
welcome.step3.detail: The installer opens it in your file manager — just select the same folder in Chrome's dialog.
welcome.step4.title: Hook up your agent
welcome.step4.detail: The installer prints a ready-made snippet with the path already filled in — paste it into your Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot / Codex config.
